title: Why we win / why we lose
intro: Every Zlarior and ATLAS trade of 2021-2026 taken apart, costs in: how far it went for and against us and when, what the day and the trends did, news, the prior day's levels, and what came after the exit.
verdict: Our losers are mostly good trades that lost: at the entry they look like the winners, the stops are real, and the trades a careful human would skip carry as many winners as losers. The money is in a few big winners.
lines: Zlarior: 62% of 2026's lost $ came from trades that never worked; skipping what a careful human would skip = -$709 / -$1,486 a month (Jan-Jun / Jul-Oct).
ATLAS: 58% of 2026's lost $ came from trades that never worked; skipping what a careful human would skip = -$2,253 / -$692 a month (Jan-Jun / Jul-Oct).
tested: 4 rules from this study were tested on the real backtests (picked on Jan-Jun 2026, checked on Jul-Oct and 2021-25, costs in): 0 passed. They stay in the ZEUS Lab and are re-tested every night.
checklist: against the daily AND the 1h trend
late: the day had already moved 1 daily ATR or more before the entry
a high-impact release within 30 minutes after the entry
the prior-day high / low sits less than 1R ahead on the target side

bots.lose_ref: 2021-25 (reference): never worked 67%, worked then turned 27%, shaken out 4%, news 1% of -$98,882 lost.

careful.line: 28 of 53 losers (59% of the lost $) passed every check: good trades that lost. The checklist would have skipped losers that lost $5,590 but also winners that made $15,429.

win: The best 20% of the 67 winners made +$42,563 of the +$43,820 net: a few big winners pay for everything.
A winner went only 0.30R against us first (median; 43% never went 0.25R against) and took 132 min (best point after 90 min).
Hindsight: 58% of winners came on days that closed our way, 35% of losers. Days that closed our way made +$37,119, days against +$7,061. Nobody knows the close at the entry.
after: Stops were real: with a stop 50% wider, 2% of the 52 stop-outs of 2026 would have reached the target first (2021-25: 4%).
A stopped trade was at best +0.25R our way (median) and was out after 34 min; an hour after the stop, price was a median 0.10R further against us.

Breakeven exits: 35 in 2026, +$140 in total; 41% of the Jan-Jun ones and 0% of the Jul-Oct ones later reached the target (other breakeven and exit rules were tested many times and lost: see Tested and rejected).
bots.chance: Known at the entry, nothing tells a loser from a winner better than chance: 18 of 86 buckets (session, weekday, VIX, trends, news, prior-day levels, setup) were worse or better in all three periods; shuffled results give 15.4.

kalshi.title: Kalshi K8 metals (paper)
lines: 465 bets 2026-08-03 to 2026-11-18: 70% won, +$2,234 at $15 a bet. A loss costs $15.27, a win pays $13.36: K8 wins by being right often, not big.
Why it wins: the cheap fills. Bets bought under 50c made +$1,106 of the +$2,234 (64% won, $18.25 a win); at 60c+ they win 83% but pay $7.87, +$307 in total. A price creeping up is the real threat.
Why it loses: gold and silver of the same window move together. Of 232 windows both won 139 and both lost 45 times: the 6 legs are closer to 3 bets a day, so a bad day costs 2 x $15.
Held-out weeks (test): 68% won, +$945; 2 of 16 weeks lost money, the newest week -$74.
